title: PE 2 / IC 2 — Engagement Team Competency Matrix
subtitle: Competence & Capability Assessment of the Engagement Team
issai_reference: ISSAI 2220 ¶26 — Competence and capabilities of the engagement team
psrec_note: The engagement partner shall be satisfied that the team, and any external experts, have the competence and capability to perform the audit and enable issuance of an appropriate audit report.

sections.title: Competency Matrix
sections.guidance: Add each team member as a column and rate them across the 8 competency aspects. The system flags any cell that falls below the minimum required for the member's role.

questions.guidance: Use the 8 competency aspects from the Lookup tab; ratings: Basic Understanding / Intermediate / Advanced.

sections.title: Interventions
sections.guidance: Document interventions for any competency gaps flagged in the matrix.

questions.text: After interventions, does the engagement team have the required competencies to perform the audit?
questions.risk_description: Engagement team lacks required competencies — audit quality risk.
questions.inherent_risk_factor: An engagement team that does not meet the minimum competency thresholds creates a pervasive risk that the audit will not be performed to the required standard.

questions.guidance: Written after the Intervention Log is complete. Justify the conclusion in S4_Q1.
